podcast.body: Patti Smith's version of the Van Morrison and Them song, featured on her 1975 album "Horses." This track showcases her unique spin on a classic and exemplifies the "powerful stuff" she was creating at the time. "Patty Smith and her spin on the Van Morrison and Them song called Gloria, that's from her 1975 album Horses."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This song, opening Patti Smith's *Horses* album, is a rewritten version of Van Morrison's original. Smith transformed it into a powerful "declaration of her own independence," featuring the iconic line, "Jesus died for somebody's sins but not mine," which set the album's raw and unfiltered tone. "It opened with her rewriting Van Morrison's Gloria and she kind of turned it into this declaration of her own independence."
